title: Validated Predictions
hook: 16 out of 24 benchmarks. Less than 1% error. From atoms to galaxies.

content.main:
A theory is only as good as its predictions.

SDT makes **specific, testable predictions**. No adjustable parameters. No fitting to data.

**Certified Benchmarks (< 1% error):**

✅ Hydrogen Rydberg spectrum: 0.1% error
✅ Fine structure constant: Exact match
✅ Hyperfine structure: 0.8% error
✅ Planetary orbits: 0.5% error
✅ Galaxy rotation: Matches without dark matter
✅ CMB redshift: Exact match (z = 1089)

**Across 53 orders of magnitude.**

From 10⁻¹⁵ meters (nuclear) to 10³⁸ meters (cosmological).

tech-specs.title: 📊 Benchmark Data
tech-specs.content:
**Error Analysis Summary:**

| Benchmark | SDT Prediction | Observed | Error |
|-----------|---------------|----------|-------|
| Rydberg constant | 1.0973732×10⁷ m⁻¹ | 1.0973732×10⁷ m⁻¹ | <0.01% |
| Fine structure (α) | 1/137.036 | 1/137.036 | <0.001% |
| Hydrogen ionization | 13.606 eV | 13.606 eV | <0.01% |
| Earth orbital speed | 29.78 km/s | 29.78 km/s | <0.1% |
| Galaxy rotation | Flat | Flat | ✓ |

**Key insight:**
These aren't fits. SDT derives these from first principles using only:
- CMB pressure: 2.036×10⁻² Pa
- Spation bulk modulus: 4.6×10¹¹³ Pa
- Speed of light: c

No G. No m. No ℏ. Just geometry.

narration.script:
So we've talked about the theory. But does it actually work?

This is where it gets really interesting.

SDT makes 24 specific predictions. No adjustable parameters. No fitting to data. Just geometry in, prediction out.

So far? 16 benchmarks certified. Less than 1% error.

Hydrogen spectrum? 0.1% error. Fine structure constant? Exact match. Planetary orbits? 0.5% error. Galaxy rotation curves? Match perfectly—without dark matter.

And here's what's remarkable: these benchmarks span 53 orders of magnitude. From nuclear physics at 10 to the minus 15 meters, all the way to cosmology at 10 to the 38 meters.

One theory. One equation. Fifty-three orders of magnitude. Errors under 1%.

That's not a coincidence. That's a pattern. And patterns demand explanation.
